instruction: Please set the screen idle delay to 3 minutes in the display power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.2); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3);
